binge.description: Strong recent-chapter activation; catches near-range repetition and over-signaling.

weekly.description: Moderate between-installment decay; stresses natural reactivation before distant payoff.

casual.description: Retains major outcomes and relationships better than labels, minor clues, or procedural detail.

puzzle.description: Actively tracks clues, wording anomalies, and competing hypotheses.

rereader.description: Knows later reader-facing outcomes and tests retrospective fairness without hidden author-only material.
